_readme: Every battery-electric car the car search offers: one entry per charging spec (battery, on-board
charger, DC inlet and peak) of the European build, with the model years it was sold.
Researched from maker spec sheets and press releases, Wikipedia, Fastned car pages, ev-database.org and
EV press; each entry lists the sources it was checked against and a confidence. Where sources
disagreed, the lower charging power was kept: an "up to" speed the car cannot reach misleads drivers.
Plug types matter most: a wrong DC plug sends a driver to a charger they cannot use.
acConnector is Type2 even for Type 1 inlets (Icelandic AC posts are Type 2 sockets; the driver brings
the cable). dcConnector null = no DC fast-charging inlet; cars whose DC inlet was an option have one
entry with it and one "AC only". yearTo null = still on sale.
Slugs are permanent (saved in visitors' browsers and URLs): never change one; add a new entry instead.
Validated by parseCarSeeds (src/lib/server/car-seeds.ts); npm run seed:cars syncs the cars table.
